R1.description: The every-field control-character test compares the complete refusal, so finished[].work_item_id cannot pass for a refusal naming not_finished[].work_item_id

R2.description: The kind and schema_version refusals count the value itself by one rule (a string without the display's quotes, a number its characters); only a string over the cut changes its printed number, 5002 becomes 5000; a list or object counts its printed form, never its elements

R3.description: The page states the limits it checks, that the 4096 limit on read_errors[].path is not a strict PATH_MAX bound, what is printed above it, and what the echoed count counts; a test pins the printed fallback; no code change for the limit

R4.description: The test of every cause builds all thirteen causes the view can return from the code and finds each, in its fixed words, on the page; the page gains the two rows it lacked (output not UTF-8, output not one JSON object)

R5.description: The page says the zero-finished header applies to a complete report; the fixture description and the chmod 000 case are checked by hand and dropped as already right or non-existent

R6.description: Each changed text or behaviour has a deterministic stub-engine test and a failure-only mutation; every other output and exit code byte-identical; a fix: title releases Manager 1.14.8; roadmap row 29 Current at planning, Done at acceptance
